name: Vegetarian Burrito Bowl
steps: Rinse rice and cook with 580 ml water and half the salt, covered over low heat for 12–15 minutes. Rest for 10 minutes and fold in half the lime juice and coriander.
Heat half the oil, cook half the chopped onion for 4 minutes, add beans, cumin, paprika and remaining water, and simmer for 8 minutes.
In a separate pan heat remaining oil and stir-fry sliced capsicum and corn for 5–6 minutes until lightly browned.
Mix diced tomatoes, remaining onion, remaining lime juice, coriander and salt for salsa.
Slice avocado just before serving and divide rice among four bowls.
Arrange beans, vegetables, salsa and avocado over the rice and serve hot and cold components together immediately.
tips: Rinse grains before cooking, use a heavy pan and rest covered before fluffing or serving.
notes: Quantities are for four adult portions. Cooking times are estimates; use the doneness checks in each step. Ingredient costs use sample rates and exclude unpriced items.
